name: smwgraphics-taiketsu-ultra-hero-gba-clouds
title: Taiketsu! Ultra Hero (GBA) - Clouds
description:
Hi. I'm here with another BG from a game I never heard of in my life. It's called 'Taiketsu! Ultra Hero ' for the GBA. The word 'Taiketsu' means 'Showdown'. The BG was used in The City stage. Originally, this BG was ripped by Omega, the one from Spriters Resource. I converted it to SMW usage by using the Lunar Magic Bitmap Pasting Feature. The best thing is that the palette is very easy to edit and the back area color is used, too. I had to fix the BG a bit with no trouble at all. Because this BG comes from a fighting game, it's recommended to set both Vertical and Horizontal scrolling of the BG to None.
Omega85 deserves the credit. I only did my job. Enjoy!
